title: Shopkeeper's gold nuggets
description: A bomb the player set down kills a shopkeeper in his shop and costs the player a heart. The shopkeeper leaves four gold nuggets on the floor; the player walks over two of them, and his money counts up by $1,000 while he throws another bomb up at the ceiling.
